steps.title: Furmint
steps.body: Furmint covers about 60 to 70% of Tokaj's vineyards. It has very high acidity, thin skins that become thinner as it ripens, and late ripening, all ideal for noble rot. It gives quince, apple, lemon, smoke and minerality when dry; honey, apricot and marmalade when sweet.

steps.title: Hárslevelű and others
steps.body: Hárslevelű, linden leaf, about 20 to 25%, adds perfume, honey and spice, with softer acidity. Sárgamuskotály, yellow Muscat, adds floral aromas in small amounts. Kövérszőlő, Zéta and Kabar are also allowed. Most Tokaji blends Furmint with Hárslevelű.

steps.prompt: Match each grape to its role.

steps.body: Hárslevelű's name means linden leaf. Its wines often smell of linden blossom and honey.

steps.title: What you learned
points: Furmint, about 60 to 70%, gives acidity and noble rot
Sárgamuskotály and others play minor roles
